1879061016.Skill_Desc: Cause the enemy to take more damage and prevent them from using most ranged attacks.\n\nLimit: One Trick per target.

1879072536.Skill_Desc: When not in combat, you can hide beneath the ground, unseen by foes, until you burst from the ground.

1879094936.Skill_Desc: This powerful chant recalls great deeds done in battle by the mighty Valar when the world was young, demoralizing your foes.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>This skill must target an enemy and is only usable in Dissonance.</rgb>

1879097880.Skill_Desc: When the time comes to enter the fray it falls to the Orcs to break battle lines. Your speed increases for a brief period of time. You gain a short immunity to incoming root, stun and daze effects. This skill can only be used while out of combat.

1879115160.Skill_Desc: Increases in and out of combat power regeneration.

1879115288.Skill_Desc: A shaft aimed to slow the movement of your quarry.

1879134360.Skill_Desc: Mastery over the Spear: Allows the Warden to perform Spear Gambits quickly.

1879139736.Skill_Desc:
You fling a fine mesh of gossamer silk at your target, giving you a small advantage in manoeuvrability.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Steals Block, Parry, and Evade from your target every 2s, while reducing their melee defences.

Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879157400.Skill_Desc: A weak AOE strike that is used often

1879158168.Skill_Desc: Flapping your wings at an enemy can push them backwards, gaining you more time to flee. Can only be used against monster player targets.

1879256856.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Yule Festival for Mithril Coins.

1879270552.Skill_Desc: A short range attack that will briefly enrage the target.

1879407128.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from the Secret Stone Returns Event.

1879440536.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from completing Zhélruka: Allegiance Level 30.

Fool your opponent by rapidly stopping your previous movement, allowing you to take a different tack.

 Dodge restores morale.
 Cut-over becomes AoE.
 Compound Attack has increased critical chance.</rgb>
